prompt_text: Explain what a Kafka consumer group is in two sentences.

dispatch_result.content: A Kafka consumer group is a logical collection of consumers that work together to subscribe to one or more Kafka topics. Within a group, each partition of a subscribed topic is assigned to exactly one consumer at any given time. This assignment is managed by the Kafka broker, which ensures that if a consumer joins or leaves the group, or if a broker fails, partitions are rebalanced among the remaining active consumers. This "exclusive ownership" of partitions by consumers within the same group is the fundamental mechanism that guarantees each message from a partition is processed by only one consumer in that group, preventing duplicate processing and enabling parallel consumption across the group.
